notes.title: Version 1.1 Patch
notes.content:

1.Added "light" blocks, cast an emissive glow with custom colors for night scenes
2.Added ability to add all blocks directly on water
3.Added in-game tutorial for first time users
4.Underwater base procedural generation for extending out world
5.Numerous graphical fixes
